verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled 'Searching your mail', which shows native search exists. One community user describes a saved filter that shows mail delivered to a specific address within the last two weeks, implying recipient and date filtering. The pack gives no detail on operators, ranking, speed, or coverage of the full mail history. missing for 10: documented search operator syntax, ranked/relevance results, evidence of search speed, confirmation of full-history indexing, independent hands-on corroboration of search precision

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: set up a filter on Fastmail showing all mail delivered to the old @gmail.com address in the last two weeks
